surface.basis: Pirelli 2025 Italian GP preview: asphalt grip 3/5, asphalt abrasion 2/5. Other ratings, not used here: traction 3, braking 4, lateral 2, tyre stress 3, track evolution 4, downforce 1.

source.notes: Projected, 12 m wide, scaled to 5,793 m. Heights: SRTM 30 m (public domain) through Open Topo Data, sampled every 20 m along it-1922 from bacinger/f1-circuits, lined up by curvature and smoothed over about 200 m.
